answer_1.quote: In this paper, we first introduce the dictionary example sentence generation problem... the task aims to generate example sentences for targeted words automatically.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU to measure the n-gram similarity between the generated examples and human references... Self-BLEU-4 (SB-4) is computed... Distinct bigram (D-2) and 4-gram (D-4) indicate the proportions of unique n-grams... we also report word Coverage, POS Accuracy and Definition Accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to further compare our model... annotators first rate the sentence fluency on a 5-point Likert scale... then assess meaning consistency on a 3-point Likert scale... finally judge whether the POS of the targeted word is consistent... we also ask annotators to rank sentences on readability.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate fluency (1-5 Likert), definition consistency (1-3 Likert), POS consistency (yes/no), and rank readability among generated sentences.
